semantic.justification: Original ICU78.3 EraRules loading, sparse era indices, encoded sentinel dates and source era lookup from erarules.cpp. Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced. Unchanged ICU78.3 libraries match16302 pinned resource, tentative-era, sparse/invalid-index, sentinel, start-date/year and YMD lookup cases. Original MIN_INT32=-1 and hasEnd=true behavior is retained; custom malformed-resource injection remains unverified.
